name: Anker 20W Box Fast Charger with Foldable Plug, PowerPort III 20W Cube Charger
description:
Anker 20W Box Fast Charger – PowerPort III Cube

Charge your devices efficiently with the Anker 20W Box Fast Charger, featuring a compact cube design and foldable plug for ultimate portability. Perfect for iPhones, Samsung devices, Pixel phones, and other USB-C compatible devices.

Key Features

Fast 20W Charging: Delivers rapid power to charge smartphones and tablets quickly.

Foldable Plug Design: Compact and travel-friendly; easily fits in pockets or bags.

Universal Compatibility: Works with iPhone 11/12/13/14, iPhone 11/12/13/14 Pro/Pro Max, Samsung devices, Google Pixel 3/4, and other USB-C powered devices.

Single USB-C Port: Provides fast and reliable charging for one device at a time.

No LED Indicator: Sleek minimalist design with no distracting light.
